texts.facts: The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act, claiming compensation of Rs.25,00,000/- for the accidental injuries sustained by him in a road traffic accident took place on 16.01.2023. Due to the injuries sustained in the accident the petitioner has become permanently disabled and lost her future income. Hence, the respondents are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation to the petitioner.
texts.arguments: Hence, she is entitled for compensation of Rs.58,732/- under the head of nutritious food, conveyance and attendant charges. 25.
